def hlp_source_under(folder):
    """
    this function finds all the python packages under a folder and
    write the 'packages' and 'package_dir' entries for a python setup.py
    script
    """
        import os
        import sys
        from distutils.core import setup
        from distutils.command.build_py import build_py_2to3 as build_py

        packages = []
        package_dir = {}
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
            if '__init__.py' in files:
                if not root.endswith('/'):
                    root += '/'
                packages.append(root[:-1])
                package_dir[root[:-1]] = root

        setup(
            name='source_under',
            version='0.1',
            description='source_under',
            author='',
            author_email='',
            url='',
            packages=packages,
            package_dir=package_dir,
            cmdclass={'build_py': build_py},
            zip_safe=False,
            )

    if __name__ == '__main__':
        hlp_source_under('../source_under')
    \end{code}
